sample_unit: admissions (7,408 retrospective plus 340 prospective silent trial)

links.outcome: Prospective silent-trial AUROC versus retrospective AUROC for vomiting prediction
links.effect: AUROC 0.730 (95% CI 0.694-0.765) retrospective vs 0.716 (95% CI 0.649-0.784) in the prospective silent trial; performance was retained, with no notable degradation.
links.quote: This model retained satisfactory performance in a prospective silent trial.

screen.reason: The study develops a risk prediction model and validates it prospectively via a live silent trial on actual patient data, but evaluates model performance rather than testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
